findings.observation: The deepest complexion and brow notch remain recognizable, but the summon’s unmistakably adult angular diamond face, high cheekbones, softly lidded eyes, longer mature midface, crooked healed nose, and balanced adult jaw are replaced by large round doll eyes, a short button-like nose, and softened childlike cheek and jaw planes.

The compact conversion retains Hali’s conditioned but not ripped construction through stable shoulder-to-torso width, lean functional limb mass, upright posture, and grounded stance without generic body-fat or muscle inflation.
Both upper arms, forearms, narrow wrists, and visible empty hands remain lean and source-relative rather than bulky or body-fat inflated; the ready-idle hand closure does not enlarge their scale.
Brown-chestnut color, swept asymmetric part, medium-loose wavy mass, tight right-side construction, and the single plum-wrapped side cluster remain source-bound and readable.

The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored gray tunic, offset fastening, divided panels and trousers, narrow reinforced cuffs, waist ties, single empty medicine pouch, contrasting plum boot laces, and practical boots preserve the verified summon without added accessories, tattoos, or markings.

Original-resolution visual measurement places the topmost hair near y=170, chin near y=619, and grounded sole bottom near y=1400: the roughly 449 px head-and-hair unit occupies about 36.5% of the roughly 1230 px standing figure, slightly above the frozen 36% maximum and not unambiguously inside the required 32–36% / 2.75–3.1-head band.

Exactly one coherent subject appears with complete hair and head, both empty hands, both boots, and the grounding shadow fully inside generous parchment margins; no duplicated anatomy or crop appears.
A grounded wide-footed three-quarter ready-idle stance, separated compact limbs, lightly closed empty hands, and clear mantle silhouette remain readable at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The cloth mantle, tunic, divided layers, cuffs, waist ties, pouch, and boots remain ordinary mortal gear; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
